text:
jamie (growth): quick post-launch snapshot — wanted to share a few early signals from the credit + onboarding experiment, and coordinate next steps for messaging and routing

alexa (content): thanks! can you TL;DR the top 3 wins/risks? also we need a short line for the launch thread later today

jamie (growth): TL;DR: 1) 50 credits cohort -> +22% activation (first 3 sessions) vs control, 2) prompt-template group shows 18% higher retention at day 3, 3) inbound routing: high-intent flows (webinar RSVP + >2 opens) are converting to demo requests at 8% which is higher than baseline 3% 

sasha (analytics): adding raw numbers: 
```
cohort, users, activated, activation_rate, day3_retention
control, 520, 102, 19.6%, 11.3%
50_credits, 530, 128, 24.2%, 13.2%
prompt_templates, 510, 99, 19.4%, 13.4%
```
routing: webinar_rsvp + 2+ emails opened => 120 users, 9 demos booked = 7.5% (rounding to 8%)

noah (pm): nice. what's the cost per activated user on the 50-credits arm? we need to compare to CAC for paid trials

jamie (growth): rough calc: credits cost ~ $0.70 per activated user on avg for this cohort (using avg tokens used in onboarding flows). still < half of paid trial CAC so looks promising for scaling.

alexa (content): for the launch thread I can pull a short narrative: "micro-credit test drove +22% short-term activation; paired prompt templates lifted early retention" — want to mention webinar routing as an ops win?

noah (pm): mention it as a lead-quality note: "webinar RSVP + engagement -> 8% demo conversion; recommending auto-route to SDR queue with high-touch cadence"

jamie (growth): agreed. question for ops: can we set up an automated tag on users who hit webinar+2opens so inbound tooling can route?

deploy-bot: Reminder: new routing rule 'webinar-engaged' will be deployed in 1h to staging if approved.

noah (pm): Sasha, any concerns on sample size / statistical significance for the 50-credit lift?

sasha (analytics): 95% CI on activation lift is +12% to +32% so it's significant. retention lift for templates is smaller N but trending positive; recommend another week of data before full rollout.

alexa (content): ok — for messaging iteration: I'll create two subject lines and two hero copies for the launch post + webinar invite. Want to A/B subject lines with 10k send cap each.

jamie (growth): good. also want to test a microcopy variant inside onboarding: "Try these prompt templates" vs "Start from a template" — small language change but we saw big differences historically

noah (pm): action items: 1) alexa publish launch post draft by EOD (include the 2-line narrative + CTA to webinar), 2) sasha extend experiment 7 days, 3) jamie enable staging route via ops after deploy-bot runs, 4) growth to run cost-per-activation calc for 100-credit variant

alexa (content): I'll drop the draft in #marketing-drafts and ping here when ready :mag: 

jamie (growth): thanks team. follow-up sync Thur 11am to decide scale. :thumbsup:
